_directive: R3 JUDGE output for the machines (knit_machine_strategist) self-improvement loop, segment T12, round 1. Neutral referee. For each R1 question / R2 self-answer, judge whether the specialist genuinely supports the answer, classify any defect (gap|contradiction|stale|overclaim|untagged|scope|ok), cite the EXACT spec location as evidence, propose a minimal concrete fix, and set a disposition (apply_now|propose|watch|none). Honesty binding preserved: gaps are FINDINGS not inventions; the three governing blockers (Ludhiana knit+LINK per-piece rate, live blended CAC, forward India duty) stay [UNKNOWN]; off-paper stays mechanism, never accusation; cotton sweater duty ~16.5% (a 6110 GARMENT rate) never ~7% and never conflated with the 8447 MACHINE-import stack. apply_now is RESERVED for high-confidence, in-scope, MECHANICAL corrections expected to still pass build.sh.
overall_health: STRONG on the qualitative spine, WEAK on quantitative precision and on synthesising already-present pieces into single explicit rules. The specialist's marquee verdicts are sound and honestly grounded: build = highest-confidence NEVER (conflicts_and_dominance[1], corroborated by DECISION_MEMO section 2 make-vs-buy row 'the single highest-confidence do-not'), 8447-not-6110 duty discipline is CLEAN with no ~7% leak (Q2, best answer in the set), breakeven honestly undecidable on the [UNKNOWN] G2 knit+LINK rate rather than fabricated (Q4), and off-paper handled as mechanism/route not accusation (Q9). No high-severity finding: nothing in the round fabricates a blocker, invents a named-builder figure, leaks the ~7% cotton duty, or over-promises AI autonomy as present capability. The material (med) findings are all of the same family: load-bearing numbers/claims narrated with more certainty or completeness than the spec text actually delivers (Q1 undecomposed $ magnitude; Q3 bands narrated as PROOF of a 1:1 bottleneck they do not prove; Q10 'capacity plan with counts' deliverable only producible as a structure-only sketch; Q11 year-old Stoll [FACT] whose downstream 'pool deepens/parts flow' consequences are narrated as fixed; Q9 subcontract default silent on its off-paper entanglement). Two findings need judgment/synthesis rather than a mechanical edit (Q6 used-Stoll toolchain-lock vs programmer-hinge; Q7 non-operational periphery-vs-core rule) and are 'propose'. dry=false: material med findings exist.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json conflicts_and_dominance[1] states build = NEVER '(~$2M-10M+ over 3-7 years for a likely-inferior result vs a sub-$20k used machine)'; capabilities[5].method repeats '~$2M-10M+ over 3-7 years [ESTIMATE, HIGH on direction]'; glossary 'core kinematic chain' and boundaries carry the qualitative wall (Groz-Beckert needles, software-only open research). Nowhere in spec or the three KBs is the $2M-10M+ figure decomposed into components or tied to a named comparable. R2 concedes this openly (Q1 gap_note).
judgments.assessment: The NEVER verdict is genuinely supported and does NOT depend on the dollar precision — it stands on the core-kinematic-chain wall + the Groz-Beckert-supplies-the-needles [FACT] + the serious-open-research-is-software-only [FACT], all corroborated by DECISION_MEMO section 2 ('the single highest-confidence do-not'). The defect is narrow: the ~$2M-10M+ magnitude is carried as an [ESTIMATE, HIGH on direction] in a way a reader can mistake for a costed engineering estimate, when it is an undecomposed order-of-magnitude heuristic prior. This is fake-precision-inside-an-estimate-wrapper, exactly the N4/N1 failure the loop guards. Correct move is to relabel the magnitude, NOT to manufacture a build-up (that would be fabrication).
judgments.proposed_fix: In conflicts_and_dominance[1] and capabilities[5].method, retag the magnitude as e.g. '~$2M-10M+ [ESTIMATE, order-of-magnitude/direction-only, HIGH on direction, not a decomposed engineering estimate]' and add a half-clause that the NEVER rests on the kinematic-chain wall + Groz-Beckert + software-only-research facts, with the dollar figure serving only to establish orders-of-magnitude separation from sub-$20k.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json boundaries[4] ('HSN 8447, ~7.5% BCD, 18% IGST') and glossary 'HSN 8447 import stack' ('[FACT on classification and 18% IGST, [ESTIMATE] on the exact BCD sub-heading, [UNKNOWN] on 2025-26 changes]'); capabilities[3].method computes landed = price + freight + ~7.5% BCD + 18% IGST under heading 8447. The specialist correctly keeps the 8447 MACHINE-into-India stack categorically distinct from the 6110 GARMENT-into-US duty trio, quotes ~7.5% BCD consistently WITH its [ESTIMATE] tag (no number-vs-tag inconsistency), asserts only classification + 18% IGST as [FACT], holds 2025-26 changes [UNKNOWN], and confirms no residual ~7% cotton figure or 6110 rate has leaked into the machine math. N5 satisfied; no defect.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json capabilities[1].method cites 'a computerised flat knits ~12-25 garments'-worth of panels/machine/shift; a linker does ~20-45 sweaters/linker/shift' and asserts these 'show linking sets the daily ceiling'; conflicts_and_dominance[0] resolves 'the linker and the CAD/flat-knit programmer dominate the iron'; competency_questions_covered item 2 claims 'how do the throughput bands PROVE it'. On the central estimates a single linker (20-45) matches or outpaces a single knitting machine (12-25), so at 1:1 the bands do NOT prove the linker is the numerical bottleneck.
judgments.assessment: A genuine internal contradiction between the cited [ESTIMATE] bands and the headline 'the bands PROVE the linker is THE bottleneck'. R2 concedes it and supplies the correct reconciliation: the bands show rough balance/overlap at 1:1, and the defensible claim is that linking is the HARD-TO-SCALE binding constraint (hand-skill, eyesight, piece-rate, T1's hardest-to-re-hire role) requiring linkers matched at/often above 1:1 to knitting (kb2's own '~2 linkers per knitting machine' hint), NOT that one linker is always slower than one machine. The load-bearing dominance rule survives on the hand-skill-scarcity fact; only the 'bands prove it' narration is wrong.
judgments.proposed_fix: Amend capabilities[1].method and competency item 2 to say the bands show knitting and linking are roughly BALANCED at 1:1 and that linking is the hard-to-SCALE constraint requiring linker capacity matched to (often >1:1, ~2:1 at the upper knit band) knitting capacity; move the load-bearing weight onto the hand-skill scarcity fact rather than the raw per-shift numbers; stop asserting the bands 'prove' a 1:1 numerical bottleneck.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json capabilities[2].method and glossary 'breakeven utilisation' give breakeven_utilisation = owned_fixed_period_cost / ((jobwork_unit_rate - owned_variable_unit_cost) * period_capacity); escalation_triggers[3] requires a decision resting on the missing job-work knit/link piece rate be flagged low-confidence and deferred (T4/T8); router honesty_discipline.governing_blockers holds the knit+LINK rate [UNKNOWN] (= DECISION_MEMO gate G2).
judgments.assessment: Correctly supported and honesty-exemplary. The specialist declines to invent a jobwork_unit_rate, states plainly that the breakeven (and the subcontract->buy-used phase-flip volume) is structurally UNDECIDABLE as a number until G2 is measured, and gives the structure-only output (below breakeven subcontract wins, above it own a used Cixing-class). This honors the 'decide around, never invent' binding. Not a defect; the only residual is presentational — some spec surfaces imply a computable threshold exists. Low-severity, already mitigated by escalation_triggers[3].
judgments.proposed_fix: Optional watch-item: ensure every mention of the breakeven / phase-flip carries 'undecidable until the G2 knit+LINK piece rate is measured' so no reader infers a computable threshold. Not required for correctness.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json capabilities[5].method names 'design->knit-program assist as the highest-value use because it offsets the scarce programmer'; boundaries[3] keeps AI a multiplier and holds design->program autonomy on our fabrics [UNKNOWN] for T8; escalation_triggers[4] routes autonomy to human_review; glossary 'AI real-vs-hype boundary'. The KB cites no measured productivity uplift for Shima APEX / Stoll M1plus specifically.
judgments.assessment: The multiplier-vs-autonomy line is drawn correctly and does NOT collapse into '[UNKNOWN] autonomy in disguise' as long as the value claim stays bound to human-in-the-loop draft-and-correct. The mild defect: 'highest-VALUE' is easy to read as 'highest-CERTAINTY', and the present-tense assist is a MED-confidence [ESTIMATE] with no cited uplift, so an unbound 'highest-value AI use' risks reading as a near-autonomy claim (N4). Low severity because boundaries[3] + escalation_triggers[4] already hold the autonomy line; the fix is a binding phrase.
judgments.proposed_fix: Wherever 'highest-value AI use' appears (capabilities[5], glossary 'AI real-vs-hype boundary'), bind it to 'programmer MULTIPLIER (human-in-the-loop draft-and-correct), autonomy [UNKNOWN]' and label the assist value [ESTIMATE, MED, no measured uplift cited] so it can never be read as an autonomy claim.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json glossary 'CAD/flat-knit programmer bottleneck' ('a Shima program is not a Stoll program') and 'Stoll flat-knit exit (2025)'; conflicts_and_dominance[4] sets buy-used Chinese-Cixing-class-first; escalation_triggers[5] defers ex-Stoll parts/service as a diligence item. No single rule states that toolchain continuity for the programmer hinge dominates a used-Stoll price bargain; the pieces exist but are not synthesised.
judgments.assessment: A real unresolved-in-one-place tension: the Stoll exit DEEPENS the cheap used pool (a reason to buy used) while locking the brand's scarcest resource — the vendor-locked programmer — into a DISCONTINUED, Obertshausen-only toolchain (a reason NOT to buy used Stoll for the founding machine). R2's synthesis (found on Cixing-class or Shima; treat used-Stoll as a diligence-gated situational buy only, never the default, because it ties the programmer hinge to a dead ecosystem) is correct and derivable from the existing parts, but is not stated as a resolved rule. This requires a judgment call about how to weight toolchain-continuity vs price, so it is a new synthesised dominance rule, not a mechanical relabel -> propose (not apply_now).
judgments.proposed_fix: Add a conflicts_and_dominance entry: 'toolchain continuity for the programmer hinge vs a used-Stoll price bargain -> resolution: toolchain continuity dominates; found the used buy on Cixing-class (live toolchain) or Shima (surviving ecosystem), and treat a used ex-Stoll machine as a diligence-gated (Obertshausen parts + programmer availability) situational buy only, never the founding move, because anchoring the scarce programmer to a discontinued vendor undermines the strategy's hinge.'

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json glossary 'periphery-only reverse-engineering rule' and 'core kinematic chain', conflicts_and_dominance[6], and boundaries[2] express the rule as two lists (core = needle bed/needles/cams/electronic selection/firmware/knit-CAD = NEVER; periphery = jigs, fixtures, alignment gauges, non-critical spares, cam-timing learning, scanning obsolete brackets = OK). No decision test is given for mechanically-adjacent borderline parts (alignment gauge, cam follower, yarn-path-touching bracket).
judgments.assessment: A genuine operational hole in an owned deliverable ('the periphery-only reverse-engineering rule'). As written it is a slogan-plus-two-lists and cannot adjudicate the borderline parts a builder actually faces — precisely where the build-NEVER discipline erodes in practice ('it's just a spare'). R2 supplies the correct conjunctive test (periphery-safe only if it is not a named core subsystem AND does not set/hold stitch-forming precision - bed flatness, gauge pitch, needle timing, cam geometry, yarn-path registration AND its failure degrades convenience not stitch integrity/safety AND it clones no firmware/knit-CAD IP) and applies it correctly (alignment gauge = CORE-adjacent metrology, cam follower = CORE, yarn-path bracket = not periphery). Adding this test is a substantive judgment refinement, not a stale-figure swap -> propose.
judgments.proposed_fix: Add the conjunctive test to the 'periphery-only reverse-engineering rule' glossary/boundary: a part is periphery-safe to reverse-engineer/3D-print only if (i) it is not a named core-chain subsystem, (ii) it does not set or hold stitch-forming precision (bed flatness, gauge pitch, needle timing, cam profile geometry, yarn-path registration), (iii) its failure degrades convenience/maintenance not stitch integrity or safety, and (iv) it clones no firmware/knit-CAD IP; anything that touches loop-forming metrology, needle timing, or the yarn path is CORE.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json capabilities[3] (downgrade tidy anchors like '~$15k used Chinese machine' to wide LOW-MED bands 'needing a landed quote'; get-a-real-quote flagged the #1 input gap) and conflicts_and_dominance[2] (wide band dominates tidy anchor); kb2 PRICE_BANDS_ESTIMATE (Chinese used ~$4,000-15,000 [ESTIMATE, MED]).

The specialist refuses to quote a clean landed number (which its own tidy-anchor-downgrade rule forbids), concedes 'sub-$20k used' is a band-on-a-band (wide FOB + [ESTIMATE] BCD + [UNKNOWN] budget changes, no landed quote), and correctly rests the build-NEVER comparison on ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE separation robust to band width rather than on either side's precision. This is the honest posture. Only residual is presentational (make the order-of-magnitude framing explicit at the point of comparison) — overlaps with the Q1 apply_now fix.
judgments.proposed_fix: Covered by the Q1 fix: when invoking 'sub-$20k vs $2M-10M+', frame it explicitly as an order-of-magnitude separation robust to band width, with the landed used figure awaiting a quote (#1 input gap). No separate edit needed.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json glossary 'subcontract-into-the-mesh default' and decision_procedure step 4 default Phase-0 to subcontracting knit+link+finish into the Ludhiana mesh, describing it as clean 'agglomeration-is-infrastructure' with no note that the job-work rate it leans on is entangled with the off-paper mechanism; boundaries route legal/tax exposure to confirmation but do not flag the off-paper dependency; router neutralize_gate N3 and SCOPE_GLOSSARY S9 hold off-paper = mechanism, magnitude [UNKNOWN], owned by ludhiana_sourcing_strategist.
judgments.assessment: A real, honestly-scoped gap. The specialist's most-used recommendation (Phase-0 subcontract into the mesh) sits on a job-work piece rate entangled with the cluster's off-paper economy, but the spec text treats the mesh as clean infrastructure and never surfaces the dependency. R2's correct handling threads all three tripwires: flag the entanglement STRUCTURALLY (fragmented, cash-heavy, thin-margin micro-trade creates general incentives for informal cash job-work / thekedar labour / patchy-enforcement inspection), name NO party, hold the magnitude [UNKNOWN], and ROUTE the mechanism to ludhiana_sourcing_strategist and the rate magnitude to mfg_economics/T4 (G2). Adding a one-line mechanism-framed, magnitude-[UNKNOWN], routed dependency flag is a mechanical, in-scope, honesty-compliant edit that adds no new claim and cannot break build (it introduces no number and no accusation) -> apply_now.
judgments.proposed_fix: Add one clause to the 'subcontract-into-the-mesh default' glossary entry (and/or decision_procedure step 4): 'the depended-on knit+link job-work rate is entangled with the cluster off-paper economy as a structural mechanism (magnitude [UNKNOWN], never a named-party act); the mechanism read is owned by ludhiana_sourcing_strategist and the compliant per-piece rate magnitude by mfg_economics (G2), so a quoted rate is read as possibly-not-fully-compliant, never as a clean number.'

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json capabilities[1].outputs promises 'a capacity plan sized off the linker-and-programmer ceiling with the matching linker/programmer count named'; validation_checklist requires capacity 'sized off the linker-and-programmer ceiling' and every buy stated as a 'buy-machine-plus-linkers-plus-programmer decision'. Yet throughput bands are [ESTIMATE, LOW-MED] and wide (12-25, 20-45), linker labour rate is [UNKNOWN], programmer availability/rate is [UNKNOWN], and the acquire-vs-subcontract gate turns on the [UNKNOWN] G2 rate.
judgments.assessment: The promised deliverable ('capacity plan with matching linker/programmer count named') overstates what the inputs support: it can only be produced as a STRUCTURE-ONLY SKETCH (role shape + rough ranges + ordering), not a costed integer sizing. R2's worked 50-sweaters/day example is honest (~2-4 knitting machines, ~2-3 linkers matched >=1:1, ~1 programmer seat by availability) and refuses to force integers, consistent with kb2's own '~2-4 knitters + 2-4 linkers ... [ESTIMATE, LOW-MED]'. The fix is a mechanical wording downgrade of the capability output and checklist item so the deliverable is meetable as written -> apply_now.
judgments.proposed_fix: Relabel capabilities[1].outputs and the matching validation_checklist item to 'a STRUCTURE-ONLY capacity sketch (role shape + machine:linker:programmer ratios + acquisition ordering; linkers matched at/above 1:1 to knitting), quantified into integer counts and cost only once throughput is measured on our steps and the linker rate / programmer availability / G2 knit+LINK rate land ([UNKNOWN] today)'.

judgments.evidence: machines.specialist.json glossary 'Stoll flat-knit exit (2025)' asserts as [FACT] 'Reutlingen plant closed 31 Oct 2025, China production ended Dec 2025, spares/service continue only via Obertshausen' and draws 'narrowing new-build to Shima plus Chinese and deepening the used pool, which reinforces buy-used'; boundaries[1] lists the 2025 Stoll exit among cited market-structure facts; escalation_triggers[5] already makes ex-Stoll parts/service a diligence defer. Current date 2026-07-01 (~8 months past the dated events).
judgments.assessment: A real staleness exposure. The dated 2025 events remain citeable [FACT] (as reported), but the DOWNSTREAM inferences the specialist leans on for a 2026 buy verdict — 'used pool has DEEPENED', 'buy-used REINFORCED', 'Obertshausen parts still flowing', 'no successor took over service' — are unverified consequences narrated with near-[FACT] certainty when they are [ESTIMATE]s resting on a ~year-old anchor and partly [UNKNOWN] post-cutoff. R2's correction is right: keep the dated exit as cited [FACT], downgrade the downstream 'pool deepens / parts flow' consequences to [ESTIMATE leaning on a dated FACT], mark ex-Stoll parts/service availability an explicit verify-before-buy [UNKNOWN], and add a refresh-the-Stoll-read review trigger. The Chinese-first default is robust to the staleness (does not depend on ex-Stoll parts); only used-Stoll-specific reasoning is exposed. Fix is a mechanical retag + one review-trigger line -> apply_now.
judgments.proposed_fix: In glossary 'Stoll flat-knit exit (2025)': keep the dated events as cited [FACT] but retag the downstream 'used pool deepens / reinforces buy-used / Obertshausen parts flowing' as '[ESTIMATE leaning on a 2025-dated FACT; post-cutoff status UNKNOWN as of 2026]', mark ex-Stoll parts/service availability an explicit verify-before-buy [UNKNOWN] (reinforcing escalation_triggers[5]), and add a review trigger to refresh the Stoll-market read; note the Chinese-first default is unaffected.
